description: Renovate proposes every version update as a pull request and merges none of them.

It covers the GitHub Actions in .github/workflows (pinned to commit SHAs with the version in a comment) and, in pyproject.toml and uv.lock, the development tools in the dev dependency group and the uv_build build backend.
The Python versions and the uv version that CI uses, and requires-python, are chosen by hand.
A release becomes an update 7 days after it is published.

packageRules.description: The inputs given to actions (setup-uv's version and python-version) are chosen by hand.
The supported Python versions (requires-python) are chosen by hand.
